reasons.correctness: SupportTicket gains `@Version private Long version` and the changeset adds `version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL`, matching the interface. Build is green, acceptance 2/2, existing tests 229/229.
reasons.convention_fit: Changeset 2026/09/24-09-2026-add-version-to-support-ticket.sql has the formatted-sql header, a `--changeset` line and a `-- rollback`. It is included last in changelog.xml under a Month YYYY comment. No existing changeset was edited.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one annotated field, one changeset, one include. It follows the existing PartnershipOpportunity @Version pattern and adds no new mechanism and no unrelated edits.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketVersionUnitTest uses MockitoExtension and no Spring context, but has one reflection check of the annotation and field type. No behaviour is pinned, for example the version being carried through a save or a stale-version conflict.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the SupportTicket files, their dependents and TESTED_BY tests, and the PartnershipOpportunity @Version exemplar before editing. The changelog layout and test patterns were found with ls and grep.
